"""Record preparation and launch the sole original fixed V160 controller."""
import os
import shutil
import subprocess
import time
from pathlib import Path

import psutil
from train_directional_bank_trial import guard,read,ref,save

repo=Path('/home/dllu/proj/demosaic')
root=repo/'.cache/quality-20261107/V160-paired-response-v1'
path=root/'plan-v1.json';plan=read(path);guard(plan)
assert not (root/'controller.claim').exists()
assert not (root/'launch-v1.json').exists()
resources={'RAM_available_GiB':psutil.virtual_memory().available/2**30,
    'local_free_GiB':shutil.disk_usage(repo).free/2**30,
    'external_free_GiB':shutil.disk_usage('/mnt/external').free/2**30}
assert resources['RAM_available_GiB']>52 and resources['local_free_GiB']>60.75
assert resources['external_free_GiB']>156.5+(plan['expected_cache_bytes']+plan['expected_new_quality_bytes_external'])/2**30
save(root/'CPU-readiness-v1.json',{'status':'pass-before-original-controller-launch',
    'recorded_unix_UTC':time.time(),'plan':ref(path),'resources':resources,
    'tests':{'command':'PYTHONPATH=src:scripts .venv/bin/python -m pytest tests/test_late_spatial_rgb.py tests/test_regional_dc_objective.py tests/test_local_excess_risk.py tests/test_delivered_spectral_objective.py tests/test_robust_spectral_objective.py tests/test_paired_response_objective.py tests/test_paired_response_data.py tests/test_coupled_sensor_noise.py -q',
        'passed':118,'elapsed_seconds':3.32,'result_source':'Actual completed tool session59981;CPU tests,not study neural-call accounting'},
    'ruff_check':'passed for new scripts/tests','reference_compiles':True,
    'inspection':plan['inspection'],'actual_viewing':ref(repo/'.cache/quality-20261107/paired-response-data-inspection-v1/actual-viewing-v1.json'),
    'new_study_reserve_policy':plan['reserve_policy'],
    'failure_history':'One auxiliary readiness command omitted PYTHONPATH: viewing receipt import and pytest collection failed before writes/test execution. Explicit PYTHONPATH corrected them;35 and118 tests passed. No scientific-stage attempt or restart.',
    'source':dict(ref(Path(__file__)),text=Path(__file__).read_text())})
with (root/'controller-v1.log').open('x') as log:
    proc=subprocess.Popen([str(repo/'.venv/bin/python'),'-P',plan['runner']['path'],'controller',str(path)],
        cwd=plan['work'],env=dict(os.environ,PYTHONPATH=f"{plan['work']}/src:{plan['work']}/scripts",
            OMP_NUM_THREADS='2',OPENBLAS_NUM_THREADS='1',MKL_NUM_THREADS='1',HF_HUB_OFFLINE='1',
            TRANSFORMERS_OFFLINE='1',CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES='0',CUBLAS_WORKSPACE_CONFIG=':4096:8'),
        stdout=log,stderr=subprocess.STDOUT,stdin=subprocess.DEVNULL,start_new_session=True)
    owner={'pid':proc.pid,'created':psutil.Process(proc.pid).create_time()}
save(root/'launch-v1.json',{'status':'original-controller-launched','owner':owner,'plan':ref(path),
    'recorded_unix_UTC':time.time(),'readiness':ref(root/'CPU-readiness-v1.json'),
    'stages':['parity','prefix','smoke','cache','train'],'restarts':0})
print(owner,resources,flush=True)
